affected_subject.reason: Identifies MonetrixVault.executeHedge/supplyToBlp, MonetrixAccountant registry and totalBackingSigned, and 0x811 slot readers.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: notifyVaultSupply registers a slot immediately after CoreWriter action without confirming 0x811 slot exists/active.

direct_effect.reason: Premature slot causes strict 0x811 read to revert, reverting totalBackingSigned and dependent surplus/settlement reads.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual relation: registration should reflect a readable/active slot, but actual registration precedes confirmation, so backing reads fail-closed.

summary: Report explains affected components, the premature registration trigger, the resulting revert of backing/settlement reads, and the expected-vs-actual slot-readability relation, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
